content.title: QUICK HOME {{FIXES}} FOR EVERYDAY AILMENTS
facts: Hiccups – Swallow a **teaspoon of sugar** to interrupt the nerve spasm.
Sore Throat – Gargle with **warm salt water** to reduce swelling and discomfort.
Bad Breath – Chew on **fresh parsley** to neutralize odor-causing compounds.
Minor Burns – Run the area under **cool water** for several minutes to ease pain.
Mosquito Bites – Rub a **banana peel** on the bite to reduce itching.
Stuffy Nose – Inhale steam from a bowl of **hot water** to loosen congestion.
Upset Stomach – Sip **ginger tea** to help calm nausea.
Headache – Press a **cold compress** on your forehead and temples to ease tension.
Hiccup Alternative – Hold your breath and count to **ten** to reset your diaphragm.
Dry, Cracked Lips – Dab a bit of **honey** on them for natural moisture and healing.
